findings.title: Call to passkey helper does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but UsernamePasswordForm defines only isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). There is no zero-argument overload in its superclass hierarchy shown here, so the services module fails to compile. Pass the context user or provide the intended overload.

findings.title: New passkey predicate disables passkeys for normal login
findings.body: The new helper requires user != null, but a normal login starts with context.getUser() == null. Both authenticate() and the error challenge now use this helper to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(), so ordinary login pages no longer receive the conditional WebAuthn UI attributes or challenge. This removes passkey login precisely when it must discover the user's identity, preventing passkey-only users from logging in and breaking the existing initial-login tests. Preserve passkey setup for an unidentified user while also supporting re-authentication.
